DISSIPL est un groupe d'enseignants spéc: DISSIPL is a group of special education teachers who give students, fellow teachers and parents the opportunity to use digital teaching tools online.
Qu'offre DISSIPL à ses utilisateurs ?: What does DISSIPL offer its users?
Ce site permet l'apprentissage par la ma: This website offers hands-on learning online. Our hands-on teaching tools are based on real, physical materials. We use them every day, especially with students who have special educational needs or learning disorders. In our teaching experience, every student can use these tools.
Les collègues enseignants peuvent aussi: Fellow teachers can also use this website as a teaching resource and a way to learn differently.
Enfin les parents sont invités à utilise: Finally, parents are invited to use these digital tools with their children to better understand school exercises, especially in reading, writing and math.
DISSIPL répond aux besoins éducatifs par: DISSIPL meets the special educational needs of increasingly diverse students. The number of learning disorders has risen sharply in the 21st century, and we believe it is important to find teaching solutions to meet these major educational challenges. Special education teachers, who adapt learning every day to their students' needs, are well placed to offer solutions, and DISSIPL is one of them.

Découvrez notre histoire, notre équipe e: Discover our story, our team and our teaching goals.
Après des années d'expérience dans l'ens: After years of teaching experience, we, a group of primary school teachers, decided to specialize in supporting students with special educational needs (SEN). As special education teachers, our job is to adapt learning for students with cognitive disorders.
Les troubles cognitifs sont variés. Ce s: Cognitive disorders take many forms. First, there are specific learning disorders such as dyslexia, dyscalculia and dyspraxia, as well as attention disorders. There are also pervasive developmental disorders such as autism, and behavioral disorders. All of these disorders disrupt a child's learning and make it hard to concentrate.
C'est justement en travaillant sur la co: It was while working on our students' concentration that we realized we needed to offer learning solutions adapted to them.
Ce site vise à proposer des premières so: This website offers a first set of solutions, and we plan to build more in the future.
L'équipe est composée de 3 professeurs d: The team is made up of 3 experienced primary school teachers who are special education teachers. After teaching mainstream classes at every level from grade 1 to grade 5, we chose to coordinate programs designed for students with special needs.
Ainsi, nous accueillons tous les jours d: Every day, we welcome students who are included in their mainstream classes but who also attend our inclusive education unit.
Nous comptons impliquer plusieurs de nos: We plan to involve several of our colleagues in the DISSIPL project.
DISSIPL vise à offrir premièrement aux é: DISSIPL's first aim is to give students digital hands-on tools. These tools help them work on school skills and the expected learning outcomes in math and language.
Mais DISSIPL est aussi un projet destiné: But DISSIPL is also a project for ALL students, without exception, because our online tools suit every school level.
A terme, le site est une solution pédago: In the long run, the website is a teaching solution for fellow teachers, who can use it on its own or alongside other classroom resources. To this end, we will invite interested teachers to train in using our online tools.
Les parents peuvent aussi exploiter les: Parents can also use the tools on the website, but as with teachers, we believe some training in how to use them is needed.
